author: Slo7i
quote: It wasn’t even worth the waiting!! Are you even serious?? The short RockStar ever made! Poor storytelling poor mechanics and physics not as they showed us in their trailers. Be real this is unfortunate.

author: Slo7i
quote: This is hands down the greatest game of all time, refined to absolute perfection. The visual overhaul is pure magic — every frame feels like a living painting that washes away stress and fills you with pure joy. Playing this is like therapy. A true masterpiece that reminds you why games exist.
game_title: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time
